national_news.title: India Secures Golden Double in Kabaddi at Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026
bullets: Both Indian men's and women's Kabaddi teams won gold medals at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 in Japan.
The men's team defeated Iran 40-34, while the women's team defeated Iran 37-34 in the final.
Sawan Barwal won silver in the men's marathon with a national record of 2 hours, 11 minutes, and 37 seconds, ending India's 44-year wait for a podium finish in the discipline.

national_news.title: EAM S. Jaishankar Co-Chairs Event on AI in International Peace and Security
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar co-chaired an event on 'AI in the Context of International Peace and Security, with an Emphasis on Maritime Security' alongside Greece's Foreign Minister George Gerapetritis.
The event highlighted the New Delhi Declaration's emphasis on democratic access to AI resources, building secure systems, and utilizing AI for economic growth and social good.
The Minister noted that AI in the maritime domain enhances domain awareness, search and rescue, disaster response, and port resilience, while also posing challenges of attribution and escalation.

national_news.title: India Urges Fair Pathogen Access and Benefit Sharing under WHO Pandemic Agreement
bullets: Health Secretary Punya Salila Srivastava addressed the UN high-level meeting on pandemic prevention and response in New York, advocating for a fair Pathogen Access and Benefit Sharing (PABS) system.
India emphasized that countries contributing biological resources must receive timely access to vaccines, diagnostics, therapeutics, and technologies.
Highlighting India's COVID-19 response, the nation supplied 300 million vaccine doses to nearly 100 countries and medical assistance to over 150 nations under 'One Earth, One Health'.

national_news.title: Media Delegation Visits Chenab and Anji Rail Bridges in Reasi
bullets: A media delegation from Bhopal visited the Chenab and Anji Rail Bridges in Reasi district of Jammu and Kashmir to review major railway infrastructure projects.
The Chenab Rail Bridge stands at a height of 359 metres from the river bed with a total length of 1,315 metres, making it the world's highest railway arch bridge with a codal life of 120 years.
The Anji Rail Bridge is India's first cable-stayed railway bridge, featuring a total length of 725 metres and standing approximately 331 metres above water level.

national_news.title: India and France Discuss EPR Reactor Deployment and Nuclear Supply Chain Localisation
bullets: India and France held discussions in New Delhi on the proposed deployment of European Pressurised Reactor (EPR) technology and nuclear supply chain localisation.
Power Secretary Pankaj Agarwal met French energy company EDF CEO Bernard Fontana to discuss regulatory reforms and pumped hydro storage cooperation.

India highlighted the draft SHANTI (Sustainable Harnessing and Advancement of Nuclear Energy for Transforming India) Rules and Regulations, aimed at enabling private and foreign participation in the nuclear sector.

national_news.title: India and Liberia launch joint initiative on maritime safety at UNGA
bullets: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar addressed the inaugural meeting of the 'Group of Friends on Safety and Security of Shipping and Seafarers' at the 81st session of the UN General Assembly in New York.
India and Liberia launched a new joint initiative to establish a consultative framework to enhance maritime safety and ensure stakeholder voice in the shipping sector.
India is a major source of seafarers, while Liberia is the world's largest shipping registry.
The initiative comes in the wake of repeated attacks on commercial vessels like MV Cape Dao and El Gaia in key waterways including the Gulf, Red Sea, and Black Sea.

national_news.title: EAM S. Jaishankar Advocates Text-Based Negotiations for UN Security Council Reforms
bullets: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar addressed a ministerial session titled 'Ruptures & Ramparts: Building Bridges for a Changing World' on the sidelines of the 81st UN General Assembly in New York.
Called for concrete, text-based negotiations and rejected the requirement of complete unanimity for UN Security Council reforms, advocating for democratic voting processes.
Emphasized the growing unity among Global South nations to break old dependencies and reshape global governance to reflect contemporary realities.

national_news.title: India Reaches 23 Medals at Asian Games in Japan
bullets: India's medal tally at the Asian Games reached 23 (2 Gold, 9 Silver, 12 Bronze) following major victories in Nagoya, Japan.
Kamaljeet and Suruchi Singh clinched Gold in the mixed team 10m air pistol event with a score of 484.6.
Gulveer Singh secured Silver in the men's 10,000m event, while Baranica Elangovan (pole vault) and Manpreet Kaur (shot put) earned Bronze medals.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Unveils Tech-Driven Preparations and Patrols for Pitri Paksha Mela 2026
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary flagged off 58 highway patrolling vehicles organized by the Home Department to strengthen road safety.
Pitri Paksha Mela 2026 in Gaya will feature AI-enabled surveillance, facial recognition for missing persons, QR code wristbands for pilgrims, and multilingual Google Translator help desks.
Comprehensive pilgrim facilities include free daily accommodation for over 75,000 people, 70 health camps, e-rickshaws, and subsidised meals via 'Jeevika Didi ki Rasoi'.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Steps Up Efforts to Expand Sugarcane Cultivation and Revive Sugar Mills
bullets: The Bihar government organized a farmers' seminar in Patna, inaugurated by Sugarcane Industry Minister Sanjay Kumar, to promote scientific sugarcane cultivation and check migration.
The state has set a target of reviving existing closed sugar mills and establishing approximately 25 new sugar mills over the next five years, including a planned mill in Begusarai.
A dedicated departmental portal is scheduled to be launched for grievance redressal, tracking applications, and scheme access, while 99.39 acres have been allocated in Warisaliganj.

bihar_news.title: Supreme Court Sets Aside Patna HC Directions on Compassionate Appointments
bullets: The Supreme Court allowed appeals by the State of Bihar, setting aside Patna High Court directions that mandated fresh appointments or promotions of compassionate appointment candidates to Class III posts.
The Supreme Court upheld the State Government policy of appointing dependents of deceased employees to Class IV posts, noting that candidates have no vested right to a particular post.

The apex court observed that the High Court's directive to convert or upgrade Class IV posts to Class III violated service discipline and the state's reservation framework earmarked for existing employees.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Cabinet Approves Maa Sita Women's University, Ramdhari Singh Dinkar University and Welfare Schemes
bullets: The Bihar Cabinet approved the establishment of Ramdhari Singh Dinkar University in Begusarai under the Bihar Special University Act, 2026, covering Begusarai and Khagaria districts.
The Cabinet approved Maa Sita Women’s University in Patna, governing women’s colleges in the district excluding those under Patna University.
Key financial approvals include ₹126.07 crore for 8 dairy projects in the Kosi region, ₹195.28 crore for Siwan Wetlands aquaculture, and ₹24.50 crore for police modernization drones.

bihar_news.title: New Amrit Bharat Express Connects Bhuj in Gujarat to Barauni in Bihar
bullets: A new Amrit Bharat Express (Train Nos. 19427/19428) has been introduced connecting Bhuj in Gujarat and Barauni in Bihar over a 2,532-kilometre route.
The bi-weekly/tri-weekly long-distance service passes through more than 20 stations spanning four states: Gujarat, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, and Bihar.
Major regional stoppages along the corridor include Ahmedabad, Kota, Mathura, Gorakhpur, Siwan, Chhapra, and Muzaffarpur.
